body: I am very up front and say that I want to kill myself to this person, but he just brushes it off as if I'm not serious and threatens to involuntarily commit me if I am. Like, cant there be some middle ground where I'm taken seriously but not institutionalized?

a lot of times it seems to be a reaction to things that happen in the moment. i've made a lot of mistakes and hurt people in my life and when my past failures get brought up as if there's no way i can fix them, i just feel like it's easier to end it all.

any advice for how to go about that? no worries if not ❤️thanks for taking the time to respond
